t: Erbauer EMT300-QC 300W electric multi-tool kit delivers powerful, precise performance for diverse trade applications. Featuring a 3.2° oscillation angle and variable speed control, this multi-tool efficiently saws, sands, and cuts various materials such as wood and metal. Ideal for professionals working on intricate joinery, plumbing, or electrical fit-out tasks. Features an all-metal gearbox and fan-cooled motor for durability, with overcurrent and dust seal protection for reliable operation. A tool-free blade change system enhances productivity. Supplied with 44 accessories and a hard carry case for convenient storage and transport.
